'''Artom Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was located in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].

==Description==
Artom Station was located near to the [[Cularin comet cloud]], a couple of hours flight from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].

==History==
Artom Station was named after [[Reidi Artom]], the discoverer of the Cularin system, and co-funded by the [[Cularin Government]] and the [[Thaereian military]]. It was operated by the [[Comet Broom Service]], who used it as a navigational monitoring post, to watch the Cularin comet cloud. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] traveled to the station and murdered the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] co-owners of the Comet Broom Service. [[Garth Ezzar]] then turned the station into a gentlemens club for wandering explorers. All the credits made were put towards [[Garth Ezzar]]'s own personal fleet of ships that would be used as escorts for the top paying customer. The station soon became extremely popular, making [[Garth Ezzar]] very rich and quite powerful.
